story.text: Morocco beat Portugal 1-0 in the Quarter-finals of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Portugal had more of the ball (76 percent to 24 percent), and Morocco created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (1.27 to 0.97). The goals came from Youssef En-Nesyri at 41:36.
